stdout: --registration:show the registration commands (they contain the cluster registration token and are left out by default); also available with: `rancher get clusterregistrationtoken default-token --namespace <cluster-id>`
--etcd:with --registration: add the etcd role to the node command (no role flag adds all three)
--controlplane:with --registration: add the control plane role to the node command (no role flag adds all three)
--worker:with --registration: add the worker role to the node command (no role flag adds all three)
--node-name:with --registration: the node `name` the node command registers (a lowercase DNS subdomain)
--address:with --registration: the node `address` the node command registers (Node Public IP in the Rancher UI), or several separated by ","
--internal-address:with --registration: the node internal `address` the node command registers (Node Private IP in the Rancher UI), or several separated by ","
--label:with --registration: a node label `key=value` for the node command (repeatable)
--taint:with --registration: a node taint `key=value:effect` for the node command, effect NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule or NoExecute (repeatable)
--windows:with --registration: compose the Windows node commands instead of the Linux ones, where the Rancher UI shows them
--debug:print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
--no-input:never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
--read-only:refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
